new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/o-u8-to-l1")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withReasonPhrase("OK")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=iso-8859-1"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withBody("{\"a\":\"\u00E9\u00FC\",\"b\":\"\u00DF\"}")
);
